description: Update an existing OpenClaw cron job in place. Wraps `cron.update`. Avoids the remove + re-add dance when you just want to change schedule, timeout, payload, or delivery. Wire format (verified live against gateway 2026.4.12+): `{ id|jobId: string, patch: object }` — pass the job id and a `patch` object containing only the fields you want to change. Older shape `{ job: { id, ...fields } }` is auto-translated for backward compat with pre-0.5.1 callers.

id.description: Cron job id (preferred). Pass either `id` or `jobId`.

instance.description: Optional OpenClaw instance to route this call to (e.g. 'default', 'work'). Falls back to the active default instance, or the OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL/TOKEN env vars when set. List configured instances with openclaw_setup_list.

jobId.description: Cron job id (alias). Pass either `id` or `jobId`.

patch.description: Fields to change (any subset of writable cron fields).

name: openclaw_cron_update
